title: helianthemum guttatum subsp. inconspicuum
intro: Helianthemum guttatum subsp. inconspicuum, commonly known as rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of gastrointestinal issues due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum guttatum subsp. inconspicuum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
